text:
maria: Promo to prod blocked — deploy-bot failed on artifact upload: gzip truncated during push. Can we hold the promote?

deploy-bot: upload failed -> registry returned 400 Bad Request; manifest digest mismatch. (auto-detect)

kevin: looking at the runner logs now. seeing `gzip: unexpected EOF` during the tarball write. likely interrupted write or disk issue.

kevin: log snippet:
```
Uploading package-20260321.tar.gz to registry
gzip: unexpected EOF
publish: computed digest sha256:abcf1234... != manifest sha256:abcd1234...
aborting upload
```

sam: checking infra metrics — node-builder-7 had I/O spike at 23:02 UTC and OOM killer activity. I'm going to cordon+drain that runner pool and reprovision. will also check object store retries.

olga: hold the promotion. we should pin canary back to last-good artifact and add a short note in the release log that we're delaying for artifact integrity. @maria can you create the pin?

maria: done — pinned canary to last-good tag `sha256:aa11bb22cc` and added reason "upload truncated, holding promo". command used: `deploy-bot pin --env canary --artifact sha256:aa11bb22cc --reason "upload truncated"` :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: pinned canary -> sha256:aa11bb22cc (traffic unchanged). To unblock: rebuild & reattempt upload or re-run upload with CI_RETRY_UPLOAD=true.

kevin: i'll kick a rebuild and add a gzip verification step to the publish job to fail faster if archive is corrupt. also will add a small retry around the registry PUT.

kevin: suggested verification steps to add:
```
# after packaging
gzip -t package-*.tar.gz
sha256sum package-*.tar.gz > package.sha256
# verify before upload
cat package.sha256 | sha256sum -c -
```

maria: thanks. we'll keep this promo on hold until we have successful upload + manifest verify in CI. target retry window 30m, will update release notes accordingly.

olga: add short note to release channel once unblocked. if infra reprovision doesn't fix within 45m we'll schedule temporary reroute of builds to eu-builders. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
